landing.title: TUMHARA PAGE. *TUMHARI KAMAAI.*
landing.sub: Reel page chalate ho? Apne followers ko Get Udaan batao aur apne link ya coupon se aayi har sale par commission kamao.

items.title: Apply karo
items.desc: 2 minute ka form bharo. Hum tumhara page dekh kar reply karte hain.

items.title: Link share karo
items.desc: Approve hone par apna link aur coupon milta hai. Reel, story ya bio mein lagao.

items.title: Commission kamao
items.desc: Har sale dashboard mein dikhti hai — kaunsi reel ne kitna becha, sab kuch.

calc.title: KITNA *BAN* SAKTA HAI?
calc.perSale: Har {product} sale par lagbhag {amount} ({pct}% commission, coupon discount aur payment fee ke baad).
calc.note: Ye sirf ek andaaza hai, vaada nahi.

items.title: {release} mein wallet mein
items.desc: Har sale ki commission sale ke {release} baad tumhare wallet mein available ho jaati hai.

items.title: Withdraw request
items.desc: Kam se kam {min} hone par withdraw request bhejo. Hum check karke UPI ya bank mein bhejte hain.

items.title: Payment
items.desc: Withdraw request ke baad {payoutTime} mein payment.

items.a: Koi fixed number nahi hai. Hum har application mein page aur content dekh kar decide karte hain.

items.q: Commission kis amount par milti hai?
items.a: Buyer ne jo pay kiya, usme se GST (agar lagu ho) aur payment gateway fee hata kar jo bachta hai, us par. Course par {pct}% tak.

items.q: Sale mere naam kaise judti hai?
items.a: Agar buyer tumhara coupon lagata hai toh sale tumhari. Warna jis partner ke link par usne aakhri baar click kiya ({window} din ke andar), use credit milta hai.
Refund ka kharcha Get Udaan uthata hai. Jo commission tumhare wallet mein aa gayi, wo tumhari rehti hai.
items.aReversed: Us sale ki commission wapas ho jaati hai.

items.q: Kya main khud apne link se kharid sakta hoon?
items.a: Kharid sakte ho, par apni khud ki purchase par commission nahi milti.
Nahi. Kamaai tumhare page, content aur audience par depend karti hai.

apply.title: APPLY *KARO*
apply.name: Poora naam
apply.emailHint: Isi email se dashboard mein login hoga.
apply.upiHint: Commission isi par bheji jaayegi. Abhi nahi pata toh khaali chhod do — baad mein dashboard se daal sakte ho.
apply.bankToggle: UPI nahi hai? Bank account daalo

success.title: Application mil gayi!
success.text: Aapki application mil gayi. Usually {approval} ghante mein approval — approve hote hi email aayega.

invite.label: Invite code (optional)
invite.hint: Kisi partner ne bheja hai toh unka code daalo. Nahi pata toh khaali chhod do.
invite.notFound: Ye code nahi mila. Sahi code daalo ya khaali chhod do.
invite.payoutLater: UPI / bank details approval ke baad dashboard mein daaloge — abhi zaroorat nahi.

none.text: Tumhara partner account abhi nahi bana hai.

pending.title: APPLICATION *REVIEW* MEIN HAI
pending.text: Usually {approval} ghante mein approval. Approve hote hi email aayega.

actions.label: Quick actions
actions.copyFailed: Copy nahi hua. Dabakar select karo.
actions.shareMessage: AI se viral reels banana seekho — sirf phone aur free tools se.{coupon} {link}

campaigns.title: KAUNSI REEL NE *SABSE ZYADA* BECHA
campaigns.empty: Is range mein abhi koi click nahi. Neeche se har reel ka alag link banao.
campaigns.builder: Har reel ke liye alag link
campaigns.builderHint: Reel ka chhota naam likho. Is link se aayi sales us reel ke naam par dikhengi.

salesList.title: SALES
salesList.privacy: Privacy ke liye buyer ka naam aur number chhupa hota hai.
salesList.empty: Is range mein abhi koi sale nahi. Ek nayi reel post karo!

leaderboard.title: LEADERBOARD
leaderboard.sub: Pichhle 30 din ki sales ke hisaab se top 10.

promo.title: PROMO *KIT*
promo.captions: Captions (copy karke apni reel ke neeche lagao)
captionItems: Ye reel maine sirf phone se banayi hai. Koi camera nahi, koi laptop nahi. Seekhna hai? Link bio mein. {coupon}
AI se aisi reels banana seekho — step by step, Hinglish mein. Free tools, sirf phone. Link bio mein. {coupon}
Editing nahi aati? Mujhe bhi nahi aati thi. Ye course zero se shuru hota hai. Link bio mein. {coupon}
hookItems: Ye reel phone se bani hai. Haan, sach mein.
Ye sher AI ne banaya hai — aur tum bhi bana sakte ho.
Camera nahi, laptop nahi. Phir bhi ye reel kaise bani?

withdraw.title: WITHDRAW
withdraw.sent: Withdraw request bhej di. Check karke payment bhejenge — email aayega.
withdraw.locked: Payout details abhi badle hain — 24 ghante baad withdraw kar paoge.
withdraw.open: Ek request pehle se chal rahi hai.

payoutDetails.title: PAYOUT DETAILS
payoutDetails.hint: Payment yahin bheji jaayegi. Badalne par security ke liye 24 ghante withdraw band rehta hai.
payoutDetails.saved: Save ho gaya. Security ke liye agle 24 ghante withdraw band rahega.

formula.title: Commission kaise calculate hoti hai?
lines: Commission = (buyer ne jo pay kiya − GST − payment fee) × tumhara rate.
Commission sale ke {release} baad wallet mein available ho jaati hai. {refundLine}
Coupon use hua toh sale hamesha coupon wale partner ki. Warna aakhri click ({window} din tak) ko credit milta hai. Khud ki purchase par commission nahi milti.
formula.refundAbsorbed: Buyer refund le toh bhi tumhari commission rehti hai — refund Get Udaan uthata hai.
formula.refundReversed: Refund hone par commission wapas ho jaati hai.

frozen.title: Account review mein hai.
frozen.text: Is dauraan nayi commission pending rahegi aur withdraw ruka rahega. Review poora hote hi sab release ho jaayega.
frozen.withdraw: Account review mein hai, isliye abhi withdraw nahi ho sakta.

team.title: Tumhari *team*
team.sub: Jo creators tumhare invite link se partner bane. Unki har sale pe tumhe bonus — unki kamaai se kuch nahi katta, Get Udaan alag se deta hai.
team.inviteHint: Ye link creators ko bhejo. Approve hone ke baad wo tumhari team mein dikhenge.
team.rules: Level 1 (jinhe tumne invite kiya): unki commission ka {l1}% • Level 2 (jinhe unhone invite kiya): {l2}%. Sirf 2 levels. Bonus bhi {release} baad wallet mein.
team.empty: Abhi team mein koi nahi. Invite link share karo — jo approve hoga wo yahan dikhega.
